author: rsi_demo
title: G18 · 拒绝
body: Generation 18 keeps the five proven algorithms unchanged and targets three measured allocation or arithmetic costs: large integer topK sets use native numeric typed-array sorting, interval merging avoids cloning every nested pair and skips sorting already ordered inputs, and prime generation replaces the odd-only segmented sieve with a carefully derived segmented 210-wheel whose precomputed transitions reduce candidate slots from roughly 50% to 22.9% of the numeric range. The prime marking argument, segment cursors, signed-zero fallback, interval immutability, and topK ordering semantics were rechecked; the combined reductions should exceed the required 5% aggregate improvement without the word-frequency regression that defeated generation 17.
